patch_description: The best prior program (combined_score 0.80) used exact-ratio stochastic coordinate hill climbing with basin hopping, while the current gradient-only version scores 0.18. The softmin gradient ascent tends to stall in shallow basins because the smooth approximation of the min is a poor guide near the kinked true objective. The fix: (1) add a single-point-move stochastic hill climber on the exact ratio _ratio, with adaptive step size; (2) run it as a refinement stage after each gradient run and again as a long final polish on the global best (this combines the gradient's fast basin approach with the climber's exact objective); (3) add fully asymmetric random 13-point seeds passed through the same pipeline, per the recommendation to break the symmetry trap of the 3-fold parametrization. Determinism is preserved via fixed seeds.
